behavior.flow: Retains acceptance_pass / acceptance_fail; acceptanceBatchId links fixed selected tasks.
behavior.firstAccuracy: Only the first effective acceptance decision is eligible; new explicit events additionally require acceptanceRound=1 and an actual pass/fail inspection. A first-round uninspected disposition excludes later reinspection from first accuracy.
behavior.history: Unmarked historical records and old clients retain their original statistical meaning. No historical reclassification or production business writes.
behavior.example: 100 selected, 10 inspected, 8 pass and 2 fail: return all 100 with first actual inspection accuracy 8/10=80%; 90 uninspected never enter that denominator.
behavior.followPass: Actually failed TIDs still return; inspected pass and uninspected remainder are released.
behavior.selection: One group per sampling panel, frozen IDs and expectedUpdatedAt, all-or-none transaction, new arrivals excluded; preview capped at 50 plus full CSV.

deployment.note: First immediate post-reload health still reached a draining old worker; activation stopped before frontend publication. A subsequent check confirmed capability and complete drain, then the new index was activated.
deployment.rollback: Only restore the prior static index while retaining a field-aware API; never route new marked submissions back to prod63.

validation.baselineFailures: Five legacy API tests reference removed QC packaging/admin_reassign or an old Demo/workflow byte comparison. Reproduced on untouched prod63; not product regressions. Two legacy pagination/toggle harnesses omit an already-existing helper; retained unchanged.
validation.scope: Synthetic data only for writes; production verification uses unauthenticated GET/health and protected-file/runtime checks.
